title: Pigmentation Treatment in Dubai | SOLAR
descr: Pigmentation treatment in Dubai at a licensed clinic in Sobha Hartland. Melasma, sun spots, post-acne marks. Protocol after diagnostics. Free consultation.

hero.8: Pigmentation Treatment in Dubai (Sobha Hartland) - Even Tone After a Dubai Summer
hero.7: September is when pigmentation shows itself. Four months of Dubai sun leave sun spots, darkened melasma patches and post-acne marks that were barely visible in spring. Now, as the UV index falls, is the right window to start: we look at your skin under the 3D Skin Test, identify the type of pigmentation and build a course of laser, peels and brightening care around it.
hero.1: Harmony XL Pro laser, chemical peels, PRX-T33, LED therapy
hero.0: A course of 3-6 sessions after diagnostics, not a single procedure.

stats.3: minutes for the 3D Skin Test diagnostics

what.10: Pigmentation is an uneven distribution of melanin in the skin.
what.9: Melanin is the skin's own defence: ultraviolet light, inflammation or hormonal shifts tell the cells to produce more of it, and it settles in patches instead of evenly. In Dubai the trigger is almost always the same one - sun exposure through the long summer, often combined with heat and hormones.
what.6: Sun spots, melasma, post-inflammatory marks after acne and age spots look similar in the mirror but sit at different depths and respond to different protocols.
what.3: Superficial pigment responds well to peels and brightening care. Deeper pigment, especially melasma, needs a careful laser approach and patience, because aggressive settings can make it worse.
what.1: It is a chronic tendency, not a one-off stain
what.0: Skin that has made pigment once will make it again under the same conditions. That is why a course is always paired with daily sun protection.

benefits.13: Why a protocol works better than a single "brightening" procedure.
benefits.10: The 3D Skin Test Janus III shows pigment at the surface and in the deeper layers, including spots not yet visible to the eye. The plan follows what the scan shows.
benefits.7: Laser, chemical peels, PRX-T33 and mesotherapy work on different parts of the same problem. Combined in the right order they give a more even result than any one of them alone.
benefits.4: Suitable for the skin you have
benefits.3: Photo type matters. Darker skin tones need gentler settings and more preparation, and we plan for that rather than treating every face the same way.
benefits.0: We repeat the scan during the course, so progress is measured against your own baseline images, not against a feeling.

whyTitle.1: Treatment starts with diagnostics, not with the laser
whyTitle.0: Pigmentation is the one skin problem where the wrong method makes things worse. So we begin by finding out what we are treating.

whyCards.9: Melasma, post-inflammatory pigmentation after acne, sun-induced spots and age spots have different causes and different behaviour. A protocol that clears sun spots can darken melasma.
whyCards.7: The protocol is chosen after examination
whyCards.6: The doctor examines the skin, asks about hormones, medication and sun habits, and only then decides whether the course starts with peels, with the Harmony XL Pro laser or with brightening care.
whyCards.3: Skin that tans easily is more likely to react with new pigment. For darker photo types we prepare the skin first, work with lower energy and longer intervals between sessions.
whyCards.0: The 3D Skin Test is repeated during the course. If the pigment is not responding as expected, the protocol is adjusted rather than simply continued.

evTitle.0: Pigmentation is one of the most studied areas in dermatology, and the evidence is consistent on one point: combined protocols outperform single methods, and results hold only with sun protection.

evCards.12: Controlled trials of superficial and medium-depth peels in melasma and post-inflammatory pigmentation report improvement in pigment scores over a course of sessions, with better outcomes when peels are combined with topical treatment.
evCards.7: Comparative studies of laser and light-based treatment for pigmented lesions show clearance of sun-induced spots, while for melasma they emphasise conservative settings and a higher risk of recurrence or rebound pigmentation.
evCards.2: Reviews of topical brightening agents and daily broad-spectrum sunscreen consistently find that maintenance care is what keeps pigment from returning after in-clinic treatment.
evCards.0: The studies refer to the methods (peels, lasers, topical care), not to a specific clinic. Results are individual and depend on the type of pigmentation, photo type and how consistently sun protection is used.

indTitle.0: From summer sun spots to a dull, uneven tone.

indItems.3: Prevention and repair after the summer season
indItems.0: If acne has left dents in the skin rather than flat marks, see Acne Scar Treatment in Dubai.

steps.13: The doctor examines the skin, discusses your history, medication and sun exposure, and explains what is realistic for your type of pigmentation.
steps.9: A full scan of the skin: surface and deep pigment, vascular component, texture and hydration. This is the baseline your course is measured against.
steps.5: Usually 3-6 sessions spaced 2-4 weeks apart: Harmony XL Pro laser, chemical peels, PRX-T33 or Dermapen mesotherapy, often with Heleo4 LED therapy to calm the skin afterwards.
steps.1: Home care and daily sun protection between and after sessions, with a check-up scan to see what has changed.
steps.0: Good to know: no sunbathing, no scrubs and no active acids without agreeing them with the doctor during the course. Broad-spectrum SPF every morning is not optional here - it is part of the treatment.

priceTitle.0: The price depends on the type of pigmentation, the area and the methods in your protocol, and is confirmed at the free consultation. Message us on WhatsApp.

priceCards.8: Harmony XL Pro laser, one area

results.6: Skin looks fresher and more even in tone. Surface spots may darken briefly after laser or a peel before they flake away - this is expected.
results.3: By the end of a typical course the contrast between spots and the surrounding skin is visibly reduced. This is when we repeat the scan and compare.
results.0: Pigmentation is a tendency, not a one-time event. With daily sun protection and supportive care the result holds; without them the pigment comes back, usually after the next summer.

faq: How many sessions will I need?

Usually 3-6, spaced 2-4 weeks apart. Isolated sun spots can clear faster; melasma takes longer and is managed rather than erased. The doctor gives you a realistic number after the scan, not before it. The number of sessions, the area and the methods in your protocol are what the price depends on, and the full course plan with its price is agreed at the free consultation.

It can, and that is the honest answer. Skin that produces pigment once will do it again under the same triggers - sun, heat, hormones. Daily broad-spectrum SPF and maintenance care are what keep the result; without them the spots return after the next summer.
Can pigmentation be treated in summer?

Some methods yes, some no. Aggressive laser settings on sun-exposed skin are a poor idea in July. Peels, PRX-T33 and brightening care can be done year round with strict sun protection. September to April is the best window for the active part of the course, which is why we start now.
Is it safe for darker skin?

Yes, with the right approach. Darker photo types react more readily with new pigment, so we prepare the skin, use lower energy settings and longer intervals, and lean more on peels and topical care than on aggressive laser work.
What should I do at home between sessions?

Broad-spectrum SPF 50 every morning, reapplied through the day, plus the brightening and barrier care the doctor prescribes. Home care is not an add-on to the course - it is roughly half of the result.
What is the price of pigmentation treatment in Dubai?
The price depends on the zones, the protocol and the number of sessions you need. It is agreed at the free consultation with the doctor, before anything is booked, and there are no hidden extras.

How much does pigmentation treatment cost in Dubai?

At SOLAR in Dubai a pigmentation course starts with diagnostics: the 3D Skin Test Janus III takes 30 minutes. Everything after that depends on what the scan shows, and the full plan with its price is agreed with you at a free consultation before anything is booked.

  • 3D Skin Test Janus III. 30 minutes. Surface and deep pigment, vascular component, texture. The starting point of any protocol.
  • Harmony XL Pro laser. For sun spots and age spots, usually as a course rather than a single session.
  • PRX-T33 therapy, face or face and neck. Brightening and skin renewal with no downtime, well suited to a course.
  • Dermapen Genosys Mesotherapy. Brightening cocktails delivered into the skin, often alternated with peels.
  • HYDROPEPTIDE Radiance Glow Facial. Supportive care between the active sessions of the course.
  • Chemical peels and Heleo4 LED therapy are priced by protocol and confirmed at the consultation.

What changes the price

  • Type of pigmentation: melasma usually needs a longer, gentler course than isolated sun spots.
  • Area: face, face and neck, hands or decolletage.
  • Number of sessions: pigmentation is treated as a course, so the honest figure is the cost of the plan, not of one procedure.
  • Method mix: laser, peels, PRX-T33 and mesotherapy are combined differently depending on your skin.

There are no hidden extras: the consultation is free, and the full course plan with its price is agreed with you before the first session.

Pigmentation treatment near you

The clinic is in Sobha Hartland, Mohammed Bin Rashid City - 220 m from the bus stop and with free parking, so it is an easy drive from most of central Dubai:

Sobha Hartland - on site · Business Bay - ~10 min · Downtown Dubai - ~12 min · Dubai Creek Harbour - ~12 min · Meydan - ~8 min · Ras Al Khor - ~10 min · Al Jaddaf - ~10 min
